name: pairs
description: Adjacent gene pairs and the SW decoy triples with their between-gene evidence, per-gene detection and abundance and the operon tests (GIAP_SPEC.md §9.3, §7.4; M6-08).

fields.name: pair_id
fields.description: Pair ID PAIR_<n>, numbered in contig (C1) then start order

fields.name: class
fields.description: Pair class: OP (same-strand operon pair), NO (same-strand non-operon), CV (convergent), DV (divergent), SW (same-strand sandwich decoy)

fields.name: gene_a
fields.description: Upstream gene in transcription order (genome order for CV/DV)

fields.name: gene_b
fields.description: Downstream gene in transcription order (genome order for CV/DV)

fields.name: strand
fields.description: Strand of an oriented pair; '.' for CV and DV

fields.name: intergenic_bp
fields.description: Intergenic distance in bp (negative for overlapping genes; summed over the gaps of an SW triple); not a coordinate

fields.name: uniop_p
fields.description: UniOP (or distance-model) operon probability of an OP/NO pair; NA otherwise

fields.name: promoter_between
fields.description: Highest promoter score between the genes; NA when the promoter layer is missing or the pair is CV/DV

fields.name: tx_rate_between
fields.description: Highest Promoter Calculator Tx rate between the genes; NA when the layer is missing or there is no TSS

fields.name: terminator_between
fields.description: Highest terminator score between the genes; NA when the terminator layer is missing or the pair is CV/DV

fields.name: detected_a
fields.description: gene_a detected

fields.name: detected_b
fields.description: gene_b detected

fields.name: p_detect_a
fields.description: Detection probability of gene_a

fields.name: p_detect_b
fields.description: Detection probability of gene_b

fields.name: abundance_log2_a
fields.description: log2 abundance of gene_a

fields.name: abundance_log2_b
fields.description: log2 abundance of gene_b

fields.name: delta_log2
fields.description: abundance_log2_b minus abundance_log2_a

fields.name: test
fields.description: Test of the row

fields.name: stat
fields.description: Test statistic (both_detected_t: delta_log2; one_detected_pmiss: abundance_log2 of the detected partner; missed_operon_decoy: |delta_log2|)

fields.name: effect
fields.description: Effect estimate (delta_log2 minus the within-operon location)

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower CI bound (NA in pass 1: ci_unestimated)

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper CI bound (NA in pass 1: ci_unestimated)

fields.name: p_value
fields.description: p-value; one_detected_pmiss: P(miss) of the undetected gene (a probability, M6-05H); NA when test = none

fields.name: q_value
fields.description: BH q-value (both_detected_t) or decoy FDR q (missed_operon_decoy); NA without a test and for one_detected_pmiss (outside the BH family, M6-index lead decision 1)

fields.name: method
fields.description: Method (student_t, detection_limit, decoy_fdr); NA when test = none

fields.name: null_model
fields.description: Null model (within_operon_t, p_detect_model, decoy CV/SW pairs); NA when test = none

fields.name: n_perm
fields.description: Number of permutations or decoys behind the p-value; NA when not resampled

fields.name: lfdr
fields.description: Local false discovery rate (missed_operon_decoy; ranks, never calls)

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-joined pair-scope flags (§9.4 Operons rna_between; M6-08 lead decision 7, extended only through this schema; tu_source_distance_model: ADR-0061). abundance_imputed is the pair-scope token (a gene of the pair has an imputed abundance); it is distinct from the gene-scope imputed_abundance of genes.tsv.
